review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is often argued by many people that public museums and art galleries are increasing lose its importance now since viewers can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer. I disagree with this view since public museums and art galleries still have vituals values in daily life, though the fact that Internet have some irrefutable impacts.

Admittedly, technology can bring individuals beneficial and convenient experiences about art and history. Things such as high-resolution images, three dimensional reconstructions and virtual reality platforms that can enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable details without living home. For example, Louvre museum in Paris offers online collection in order to help people all around the world who cannot afford or have mobility issues still have chance to access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I strongly believe that public museums and art galleries are still necessary. Initially, online experiences cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artwork in persons, since this activity can evoke viewers' emotions and sense of authenticity which digital images cannot convey. This can seen in the way people directly enjoy historical objects in museum such as a soldier uniforms, a old gun or a flag. Moreover, museums and galleries are vital cultural hubs that symbolize the identity of a region because of they can be a magnet for tourism and a facilitator of bonding within the community.

In conclusion, technology can help people enjoy masterpieces or artefacts more easily; however, public museums and art galleries still have many irrefutable importance that cannot seen without enjoying in-person.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai đoạn thân bài và kết bài đầy đủ.

review.overall: Em viết đủ bốn phần, giữ lập trường phản đối và tự chọn quân phục, súng cũ, lá cờ làm ví dụ phù hợp. Nhưng các khung nền đã học chưa được tự soát: “Things such as ... that can enable” là mảnh câu thiếu động từ chính; “because of they can be” sai cấu trúc và đảo chiều nguyên nhân–hệ quả; kết bài “cannot seen” thiếu be. Ngay ý ở mở bài cũng làm nhẹ dự đoán của đề. Bài còn ẩu ở khâu kiểm câu hoàn chỉnh. Em cần nghiêm túc, cầu thị sửa từng câu được đánh dấu, giải thích vì sao hiện vật thật gợi cảm xúc rồi tự kiểm lại chủ ngữ–động từ trước khi nộp.

task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
